name: TOMODACHI LIFE: LIVING THE DREAM
message:
Take a picture and render a stylized, high-fidelity scene capturing a quirky, minimalist character resembling an expressive avatar with a smooth, glossy plastic texture, stylized facial features, and distinct black bead eyes. The character is placed in an explicitly surreal, blocky, yet highly detailed indoor or outdoor environment. The setting is structured like a vibrant diorama or miniature stage set with clean geometric lines, soft ambient occlusion shadows, and bright, flat pastel tones contrasted by vivid accent colors. The lighting mimics a warm studio softbox, casting a gentle sheen on surfaces. The focal character is engaged in [SITUATION] inside a [LOCATION], wearing a [QUIRKY ACCESSORY]. Shot with a shallow depth of field, tilt-shift lens perspective, making the bizarre social vignette feel like a high-end designer collectible toy come to life.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Ensure the character's skin texture remains completely matte and smooth, reminiscent of a premium vinyl art toy or Nintendo Mii aesthetic, avoiding any complex skin pores or realistic human wrinkles. Maintain clear, sharp geometric edges on all furniture and environments. Use soft, non-directional studio lighting to preserve the clean, low-poly diorama feel while emphasizing realistic plastic and fabric material interactions.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
photorealistic human skin, hyperrealistic anatomy, dark gritty realism, complex organic textures, muddy environments, cinematic film grain, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, intricate gothic architecture, blurred characters, messy line work, text, watermarks, corporate branding.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Highly recommended. The charm of the source material relies on completely unpredictable, randomized combinations of mundane social situations, absurd costumes, and flat diorama environments to produce emergent visual comedy.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
This preset utilizes an Option Groups structure because the visual humor relies entirely on combinatorial absurdity—mixing an oddly specific emotional crisis with a mundane or bizarre location and an unfitting wardrobe piece. By keeping the core prompt fixed on the distinct "vinyl art toy meets Mii avatar" rendering style, the architectural space and character material remain beautifully consistent. The user varies the situation, location, and accessory variables to generate an endless variety of distinct, humorous narrative snapshots that capture the exact chaotic energy of the game's iconic image-sharing culture.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Miniature diorama photography meets premium vinyl toy design. The perspective relies heavily on clean, tilt-shift framing that transforms digital spaces into tactile, physical-looking collectibles.

Atmosphere: Deeply surreal, brightly satirical, and delightfully awkward. It balances clean, joyful minimalism with chaotic, deadpan comedy.

Framing Tendencies: Centered, symmetrical medium shots. The camera stays level, treating the scene like a physical stage play or a dollhouse compartment.

Emotional Tone: Deadpan absurdity. Characters treat utterly ridiculous situations with absolute, dramatic sincerity.

Material Language: Smooth matte vinyl, glossy colored plastics, clean painted wood, and untextured, flat fabrics. Everything feels touchable but synthetic.

Color Relationships: Dominant soft pastel backdrops (mint, lavender, peach) punctuated by loud, highly saturated primaries (crimson red, electric blue, canary yellow) for characters and key props.
